_doc: What tools/slice_sheets.py cuts from each Gemini master in art_src/, and how it packs the cells into the game's atlases (PLAN.md 6.3, ART_PROMPT.md). Cells are numbered in reading order from 1; a cell not listed is skipped. Kinds: material (a seamless greyscale texture: cut inside the gutters, edges evened out so it tiles), overlay (greyscale, cut inside the gutters, not tiled), keyed (artwork on a flat background, flood-filled from the cell border and composited over `base`).

tiles_materials._doc: Generated 2026-10-26. Gemini drew 15 generic panels instead of the list; picked by look (ART_PROMPT.md review).

tiles_cores_shields._doc: Generated 2026-10-26. Row 1's four cores came back identical, so one is used. Row 2 cell 2 has a frame round it, so it isn't seamless and is skipped.

parts_thrusters._doc: Generated 2026-10-27. Gemini drew the nozzles about as long as tall, not half as long; squashed to the game's 2:1 they still read (ART_PROMPT.md review). One per type: pulse 2 (vents and a white band), jet 7, ion 11 (the hole grid).

parts_guns_1._doc: Generated 2026-10-27, the first of three runs of one prompt (A.3). Picks by the owner; the rest are in `spares`, kept for v2's faction arsenals (PLAN.md 9).

parts_guns_2._doc: Run 2 of 3 (A.3); the base sheet, since its line weight matches run 1.

spares.6: seeker pod with dome (stood in until A.3b)

parts_guns_3._doc: Run 3 of 3 (A.3). Heavier outlines, and housings so big (r 110 px) that the barrels end 1.1 r out: fitted to a muzzle, the disc would be wider than a tile. The owner's flak (4) and seeker (6) picks were re-rolled as parts_guns_flak_seeker (A.3b).

parts_guns_flak_seeker_1._doc: Generated 2026-10-27, run 1 of 3 of the A.3b re-roll: small housings and long guns as asked, plainer than run 3. Its seeker is used because run 3's missiles angle up-right (about 10 degrees off their line of fire) and its disc spills well past a tile.

parts_guns_flak_seeker_3._doc: Run 3 of 3 of the A.3b re-roll; the owner's favourite. Housings still big (r 96 px, barrel tip 1.56 r), so the flak's disc is a little wider than its tile (1.09 U), which suits a heavy gun. Run 2 is pixel art on square bases and isn't used.

parts_guns_edge_v2_1._doc: Generated 2026-10-27, run 1 of 3 of the A.3c edit of ref_turrets.png: each turret's round base swapped for a narrow hull bracket, the gun unchanged. The fixed mounts. Its mine dropper grew a second mine on a chain, off-centre, so run 2's is used.

spares.7: mine dropper with a chained second mine

parts_guns_edge_v2_2._doc: Run 2 of 3 of the A.3c edit. Gemini kept half the disc on a tall bracket, which reads as a pivot: the swivel mounts. Mines and EMP can't swivel; its mine dropper is the fixed one.

parts_guns_edge_v2_3._doc: Run 3 of 3 of the A.3c edit: like run 2 on wide plates with a white stripe. Bulkier; all spares.

fx_mines_1._doc: Generated 2026-10-27, run 1 of 3 (A.3d); all twelve were on brief. #2: spikes for the silhouette at 40 px, and a riveted ring so it looks built.

icons_main_2._doc: Generated 2026-10-27, run 2 of 3 of one prompt (A.4); all three came back nearly identical, and this one has the brightest Tech green and all-cream button symbols. Badges 9-12 are the x2-x5 power-ups (the game writes the number).

chrome_panel_2._doc: Generated 2026-10-27, run 2 of 3: symmetric corners and evenly spaced LEDs (ART_PROMPT.md review).

chrome_header_3._doc: Generated 2026-10-27, run 3 of 3: matching end caps, an even field.

chrome_frame_2._doc: Generated 2026-10-27, run 2 of 3: the brackets come in mirrored pairs. Its black middle is cut out (holes).

chrome_buttons_1._doc: Generated 2026-10-27, run 1 of 3: the same button in every row, the states clearly apart. Cell 14 is a fill drawn inside its track, so the fill is its left part.

portraits_man_jacket_1._doc: Generated 2026-10-27 (A.7), the moods in reading order. Gemini made the jacket a sleeveless vest; head ~27% of the cell.

portraits_man_suit_1._doc: Generated 2026-10-27 (A.7), the moods in reading order. An image edit of portraits_man_jacket_1: the same man, pose and crop in the space suit.

portraits_woman_jacket_1._doc: Generated 2026-10-27 (A.7), the moods in reading order. Head ~33% of the cell, cut at the ribs; thin black grid lines (inset).

portraits_woman_suit_1._doc: Generated 2026-10-27 (A.7), the moods in reading order. An image edit of portraits_woman_jacket_1.

portraits_npc_villain_1._doc: Generated 2026-10-27 (A.7), the moods in reading order. The generic villain stand-in, in its own colours.

portraits_npc_ally_1._doc: Generated 2026-10-27 (A.7), the moods in reading order. The generic ally stand-in, in its own colours.

tile_atlas._doc: The ship shader's materials: a column per tile type (visuals.json vis.tiles.material_atlas `cells`), a row per variant. R = detail, G = untinted trim (the art's near-white). The thruster column holds one nozzle per type, a row each (visuals.json `thruster_rows`), with B = cut out (A.2).

gun_atlas._doc: GunView's guns (A.3, A.3c): a row per mount type (visuals.json vis.weapons.atlas `mounts`), a column per gun in vis.weapons `atlas_cells` order, 256 x 256 cells (RGB grey, A coverage; the pivot at 96, 128 for a turret and 8, 128 for an edge gun, the barrel tip at x 248), then a trim-mask row per art row. Mines and EMP can't swivel, so those cells are empty.

icons._doc: One 128 px RGBA PNG per icon (visuals.json vis.icon.<id>), for Buttons and the pickups.

fx._doc: Sprites drawn by the flight effects (visuals.json vis.fx.<id>), one 128 px RGBA PNG each.

tile_damage._doc: Damage overlays multiplied over a tile, one per wear step 1-4 (R = the overlay, white = no change).

ui._doc: A.5's chrome (visuals.json vis.ui.<id>): RGBA PNGs cut tight, at twice the size the game draws them; UiTheme makes 9-slice styleboxes of them.

portraits._doc: A.7's portraits (visuals.json vis.portrait.<id>), one 512 px RGBA PNG per mood, each its whole cell so the head crop is one rect per sheet.
